capabilities: Apply frontmatter and tag operations to selected notes
Connect a Constance account and buy credits
Send selected input to an AI service
disambiguation: Not a general AI assistant; its main job is bulk frontmatter and tag operations.
extras: Billing and AI features require a Constance account; purchases use Paddle in USD. Error reports go to Datadog, while a local diagnostic buffer is separate. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Bulk frontmatter and tag changes across many notes are error-prone without preview and rollback.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.
New purchases use Paddle and USD.
plugin error reports sent to Datadog

summary: Bulk frontmatter and tag editor for selected notes with preview, apply, and rollback, plus optional Constance account billing.
